title: Deka built-artifact manifest v2
description: Normative schema for dist/build-manifest.json, the deployment descriptor emitted by `deka build` and consumed by `deka serve` / `deka run` and the Worker adapter. Spec: docs/architecture/built-artifact-manifest-v2.md. Strict by design: adding a field is a format-version bump (`format` carries the version).

origin.description: authored: in-project dist/, never regenerated implicitly, invalid means fail. materialized: runtime-owned user-global cache, invalid means discard and re-materialize.

producer.description: Informational. Never gates serving; see compat.runtime_abi for the load-bearing version.

runtime_abi.description: Exact integer the serving binary must implement. Bumps only when the host-module contract changes, not per deka release.

targets.description: Must include the target being served.

host_imports.description: The ONLY legal bare specifiers in server modules. deka:dev/* is never legal.

index.description: The client harness document. Omitted only when the build emits no harness.

module.description: dist-relative path. Must resolve inside dist/server/ (the resolution jail) and be listed in payloads.

methods.description: api kind only; uppercase HTTP methods, sorted. Empty for other kinds.

entry.description: dist-root-relative shim filename (_worker.js). Present only when a worker shim was emitted.

routes.description: Sorted by template. The route->entry mapping; how request-time and api routes dispatch.

outputs.description: Static and static_params routes only; prerendered HTML under client/.

entry.description: server.entries[].id. Required (non-null) for request_time and api; null otherwise.

source_file.description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. No consumer may resolve, read, stat, or fall back to this path.

file.description: Source path. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, like routes[].source_file.

module.description: Ordinary artifact module replacing v1's deka:dev/<id> virtual import.

observations.description: Filesystem observations for deka dev invalidation (deka#725). Dev metadata only; always [] in an authored manifest.

payloads.description: Every regular file under dist/ except the three descriptor files (build-manifest.json, build-manifest.sha256, build-manifest.sig). Sorted by path; forward-slash, dist-relative.

path.description: client/ and server/ trees, plus the dist-root worker shim (_worker.js). The three descriptor files are never payloads.

payload_root.description: sha256 over, for each payloads entry in path order, the bytes "<path>\0<digest>\n". Summarises the payload set; hashes the payload table, never the manifest.

digest.description: Every digest is "<alg>:<lowercase-hex>"; alg is sha256 for format v2.
